highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and delivers a broad managed-layer performance sweep with WASM .NET 11 support.
highlights_body: A wave of allocation-free optimisations cuts overhead in HarfBuzzSharp buffer encoding, shaper span reads, tag parsing, and SKColor conversions. The WASM target gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11, and a CPU raster regression introduced upstream is restored.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances to m151 with multiple upstream cherry-pick syncs that apply rendering correctness and stability fixes.

bullets.lead: CPU raster shader context restored to fix rendering regression
bullets.detail: An upstream change removed SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT, causing a CPU raster rendering regression. The flag is restored to keep existing raster output correct while the longer-term migration is planned.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse and TryParse gain ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, reducing allocations in hot parsing paths. Hex parsing is also optimised internally.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was not released when the crop-rect overload succeeded, leaking one native image reference per call.

HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encoder. Tag.Parse in HarfBuzzSharp and SKFourByteTag eliminate a per-call char[4] heap allocation. SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans. SKColor and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply conversions are ported to managed integer math, removing P/Invoke round-trips.
A macro redefinition in the Skia submodule caused a build warning on WASM. The submodule is updated to drop the duplicate definition.

bullets.lead: Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions
bullets.detail: The unsafe keyword on GRContextOptions had no effect and was removed, keeping the public API surface clean.
New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries ship the WASM native assets for .NET 11, including builds with the new exnref exception-handling model required by the upcoming runtime.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Fixed the WASM SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM macro redefinition, added Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM support, and built the cross-backend visual regression test harness.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 added preview-.NET WASM tests to catch exception-handling regressions, delivered Emscripten 5.0.6 exnref builds, restored the CPU raster shader context to fix a rendering regression, and merged the final upstream m151 stability fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the performance sweep: allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 encoding, zero-copy SKShaper span reads, eliminated tag-parse heap allocations, managed SKColor/SKPMColor conversions, and the SKColor ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing overloads.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 updated Skia to milestone m151 and merged the initial upstream m151 bug fixes and engine foundation.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships allocation-free UTF-8 buffer encoding via a pooled encoder, eliminates per-call char[4] heap allocations in Tag.Parse, and extends WASM support to .NET 11 via Emscripten 5.0.6.
